hypothesis: A passage may be genuinely causal in its donor and still repeatedly recommend a harmful skill elsewhere. Estimate the out-of-dialogue contribution of adding each case before allowing it to alter a new history. Do not flip any physically verified label.
training: Use only the 12 early fully measured windows from six training dialogues. For every held target H, donor case G and separate inner history X, exclude H and X as case sources and exclude H, X and the individual source case's own history from each reference distribution (24 reference sessions 5-12). Use only the original native root/conditional probabilities for inner scoring, never an anchor fitted on H. Add and remove G in the strongest-positive/negative combination under identical conditions. For root reliability hold both suffix policies native; for suffix reliability hold root visitation native. Compute mean per-question exact F1 contribution over both measured windows of X. X equal to H or G contributes no vote. A whole-history gain above 1e-10 is one positive vote, below -1e-10 one negative vote; ignore exact zero. Set the nonnegative weight to max(0,(positive-negative)/(positive+negative+2)). Freeze separate root and suffix fits and every local source-only correction. Do not learn from the later 88/378 or long-prefix questions.
deployment: Use the same original 32-session calibration for target matches, then multiply case strength times signed credit times its stage-specific reliability before the signed extrema. The base remains the same repaired raw-return actor. Compare unweighted joint evidence, the original passage parent, the raw anchor, uniform case weights equal to the donor weights' mean, cyclically reassigned reliability weights, native and terminal PPO. Verify the unweighted offsets and physical old expected F1. Apply to the complete four-path early, donor and replica panels and to all 40/378 randomized later examples, with the same cost and matched-rate controls. Long-prefix evaluation uses the frozen suffix weights and its own numeric lock.
interpretation: This follow-up was designed after the earlier group diagnostics exposed a negative training effect. Separate any already-scored branch on either backend from prospective results at its own lock. Both the group pilot and the inner estimates are exploratory. The full witness variant requires all rank interventions, complete later and replica cohorts, >=.02 local F1 over native and terminal, positive HT over both, better than raw, unweighted, parent, uniform, rotated and matched, >=4 histories above matched rate, positive strict and exact replication gains over native and raw before independent development.
